title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: At Clover View Junior High, one half of the students go home on the school bus. One fourth go home by automobile. One tenth go home on their bicycles. The rest walk home. What fractional part of the students walk home?

solutions.text:
The students who ride make up

\[ \begin{aligned} \dfrac12 + \dfrac14 + \dfrac{1}{10} &= \dfrac{10}{20} + \dfrac{5}{20} + \dfrac{2}{20} \\ &= \dfrac{17}{20}. \end{aligned} \]

So the fraction who walk is \(1 - \dfrac{17}{20} = \dfrac{3}{20}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Give the fractions a common denominator to add them
Subtract the total who ride from \(1\) (the whole group)
